Re-raise suppression (tools.ts:1395-1401 D-13 guard) queries status:'dismissed'; dedup (tools.ts:1370-1381) keys contentHash + status:{not:'rejected'} — a dismissed row still suppresses re-flag AND blocks duplicates. undo/route.ts:80 rejectedAt:null is a writer, harmless post-fix.

D58.defect: The prior fix only plumbed the worker SSE (`documentIds: result.documentIds ?? []` at agent-worker.ts:~865). But AgentResult.documentIds is NEVER populated: orchestrator.ts declares `const documentIds: string[] = []` (:224 runAgent, :334 continueConversation), passes it to runToolLoop (:393) and never pushes. executeWriteDocument (tools.ts:1064-1126) returns a prose 'Created X (id: ...)' string, recording the id nowhere structurally. Every SUCCESS completion still emits []. The new worker test passes only because it MOCKS the orchestrator result (completedResult({documentIds:['doc-a','doc-b']})) — it proves worker plumbing, not the defect. This is the fabricated-PASS failure mode the campaign exists to catch (cf. D-45).

books/[id]/agent/route.ts:546-551 inline success (spreads ...result) — plumbing OK / still []

D58.required_fix: Populate documentIds at the SOURCE: thread a doc-id sink through ToolContext so executeWriteDocument records each created/updated doc id; runToolLoop owns the array and returns it in AgentResult.
